method_expansion: Kinetic-Conservation Reconciliation for the DSMC cavity

scientific_role.observed_failure: MV12 did not beat paired Raw_B10 for q_y at the locked primary condition
scientific_role.root_cause_hypothesis: q_y is a weak signed third central moment with substantially higher relative DSMC sampling variance than velocity, temperature, or q_x
scientific_role.purpose: test whether machine vision adds measurable information when a direct B1 kinetic third-moment observation is softly reconciled with exact collision-invariant Boltzmann moment balances

kinetic_physics_contract.direct_fields: rho, u, v, w, T, Pxx, Pxy, Pxz, Pyy, Pyz, Pzz, qx and qy are reconstructed directly from the indexed additive moments of the exact B1 DSMC block
kinetic_physics_contract.exact_balance: steady monatomic Boltzmann internal-energy moment: div(q)=-(3/2)n k_B u.grad(T)-P:grad(u)
kinetic_physics_contract.weak_form: finite-volume vertical interval integrals of d(q_y)/dy are used at local, multiscale and coarse spans
kinetic_physics_contract.statistical_model: generalized least-squares observation fidelity weighted by a preregistered third-moment variance proxy proportional to rho^2 T^3/N_cell
kinetic_physics_contract.wall_mode: no wall heat flux is prescribed; first and last cell rows remain noisy kinetic observations and are corrected only through the same soft GLS objective
kinetic_physics_contract.additive_constant_mode: anchored exclusively by direct q_y observations, never by a boundary closure

ablation_contract.machine_vision_contribution_rule: the hybrid must beat both vision-only and physics-only at the primary condition; otherwise no q_y machine-vision contribution is claimed
ablation_contract.equal_information_rule: physics-only and hybrid use the same indexed B1 raw moment block and the same weak-balance selection matrix; neither sees B10 or legacy labels during prediction

selection_contract.data: MV9 development validation conditions and labels only
selection_contract.score: separately for physics-only and hybrid, among candidates reducing the development weak energy-balance residual by at least 15 percent, minimize condition-balanced q_y RMS-normalized RMSE
selection_contract.tie_break: lower lambda, fewer macro smoothing passes, lexical span name

analysis_contract.authorization_rule: all legacy gates including hybrid superiority over both single-component arms must pass before separately locking fresh unseen DSMC seeds
analysis_contract.failure_rule: report which arm failed; do not call the method machine-vision acceleration and do not tune on legacy labels

method_basis.concept: DSMC statistical uncertainty for heat flux
physics-informed super-resolution and denoising of fluid fields
